configuration.comment: select all columns from account table, filtered by [primarycontactid] is null and [revenue] greater than 1000000
configuration.query: What accounts do not have contacts with annual revenue of over a million dollars

configuration.standardsql: SELECT * FROM [Account] WHERE [primarycontactid] Is Null AND [revenue] > 1000000
